name: Love Is in the Air
source:
The secret of flying is this - you have to do it immediately before your body realizes that it's defying the laws. And what will happen when HE flies into your life? Are you ready to find out? This is a kind of love that happens only once in a lifetime. This is your Love Story...

[From in-app]
translation:
飞行的秘密就在于——你必须在你的身体意识到它违反法律之前立即飞行。当他飞进你的生活时会发生什么？你准备好找出答案了吗？这是一种一生只有一次的爱情。这是你的爱情故事…

[来自应用程序内]
